name: Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench: SambaNova SN40L x8, SambaFlow, Llama-3-70B BF16, 128in/128out, batch 16
unit: tok/s aggregate across 16 batched requests on 8x SN40L
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench, arXiv:2411.00136, All_results.csv). FP16/BF16 weights, 128 in / 128 out. Throughput = batch*(in+out)/end-to-end latency = AGGREGATE over the batch, NOT per-request decode tok/s. Batch 16, 8x SN40L. Latency 3.901s.
